name: Samuel Wang
intro: I'm a roboticist based in the San Francisco Bay Area, passionate about building robots that can understand their environment, take on intelligent tasks, and make a real, positive impact on people's lives.

I was born in Southern California, raised in Taiwan for 20 years, and moved back to the States for grad school and work. I hold **an MS in Robotics** from Carnegie Mellon University, and **an MS and BS in Mechanical Engineering** from National Chiao Tung University (交通大學).

I built an RC Quadcopter back in 2015 for fun and then accidentally kept working on flying drones for over a decade now. Since then, I've worked at four drone companies: **Near Earth Autonomy**, **DJI (大疆)**, **Skydio**, and most recently **Zipline**. Drones are an incredible platform, challenging enough to be a serious robotics problem, yet practical to make an incremental impact on everyday life. Plus, there's something oddly satisfying about analyzing aerial images from 300 feet up.

items.title: Launched the NightSense Product
bullets: Led the cross-functional development from the first prototype through several generations of hardware, X2, X10 and R10
NightSense enables autonomous visual navigation in no-light environments and unlocks true 24/7 all-day, all-night autonomy

items.title: Launched the X10 Drone
bullets: Developed the visual-inertial odometry (VIO), learning-based obstacle avoidance, GNSS/INS navigation, and factory calibration systems using six fisheye navigation cameras, a high-resolution gimbal camera, a thermal camera, IMUs, GPS, and a barometer

items.title: Launched the Vision Positioning Feature
bullets: A vision-based algorithm that enables Skydio drone to map the environment and relocalize itself within the map for repeatable misions.

items.title: Launched the 3D Scan Feature
bullets: An autonomous drone solution to automate flight profiles and data capture in unstructured environments, enabling the creation of high-res digital twins, orthomosaics, and accurate 3D models

items.title: Lauched the L1 Lidar Payload
bullets: A LiDAR-based payload for cm-level survey mapping and real-time visualization, integrating LiDAR, camera, IMU, and RTK sensors

items.title: Gave a Talk at IROS 2019
bullets: On vision-based autonomous drones
